title: Mark Ruffalo Called Out Over ‘Extremist and Antisemitic Messaging’ by Simon Wiesenthal Center, Creative Communities For Peace
content:
ByK.J. Yossman

Two prominent Jewish advocacy groups have called outMark Ruffalofor spreading “antisemitic tropes.”

“Words matter, and so does the willingness to draw a line when legitimate debate gives way to antisemitic tropes,” said Jim Berk, CEO of the Simon Wiesenthal Center.

“We commendParamountfor speaking clearly and refusing to allow prejudice to masquerade as political or corporate criticism. At a time when antisemitism is too often minimized, rationalized, or repackaged in more socially acceptable language, this kind of moral clarity matters.”

Ari Engel, executive director of Creative Community for Peace, also said in a statement: “Mark Ruffalo’s rhetoric has increasingly crossed the line from criticism of Israel into extremist and antisemitic messaging.”

Their intervention comes afterParamount issued a rare statementof condemnation against Ruffalo on Friday, in which the company said it is “troubled when antisemitic tropes are invoked in purported service of a business dispute.”

That statement was in response to the actor’s Instagram re-posting of a year-old video clip featuring Jewish Paramount Skydance board member Safra Catz speaking on a panel. In text accompanying the clip he told his 20 million Instagram followers it showed Catz “revelling” in a “genocide” powered by tech company Oracle, understood to be a tacit reference to the Israel-Hamas conflict.

Catz is the former CEO of Oracle, which was co-founded by Larry Ellison, father of Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison.

Paramount Skydance is in the process of acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery. Ruffalo has beenone of the most vocal criticsof the deal.

In his latest social media screed, Ruffalo said Larry Ellison was funding his son’s acquisition of Warner and that he would own “most of” the company if the deal, which is currently mired inlegal tangling with 12 state attorneys general, went through.

Larry Ellison has reportedly committed up to $46.7 billion of the $111 billion deal, witha trio of Middle Eastern sovereign wealth funds, comprised of Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Abu Dhabi, also committing at least $24 billion.

Ruffalo, who is believed to have earned millions from his role as Hulk in the Marvel films, also called Ellison Sr. a “classic Oligarch” who is “crushing workers and consolidating the wealth of the world for their own power and concentrated dominance” in his commentary. He also accused the Ellisons of “powering some of the most destructive and inhuman forces in the world.”

After Paramount issued its statement condemning his post, theMarvel actor fired back on X, saying the accusation of antisemitism “is appalling and fundamentally dishonest.”

However, at least two Jewish orgs appear to agree with Paramount’s assessment. “Invoking Israel in an issue where it is completely irrelevant is a textbook case of obsession and demonization,” Berk, the Simon Wiesenthal Center CEO, continued in his statement. “Paramount was right to call it out. More leaders and institutions should have the courage to call antisemitism what it is, regardless of who is spreading it.”

Meanwhile CCFP’s Engel, noted: “Ruffalo now says accusations of antisemitism against him are ‘fundamentally dishonest.’ Intent does not erase impact. Repeatedly amplifying inflammatory falsehoods and rhetoric that mirrors historic antisemitic tropes helps normalize the violent anti-Jewish hatred we are seeing take hold once again around the world, regardless of how he chooses to describe his own motives.”
title_zh: 馬克·魯法洛(Mark Ruffalo)因「極端主義和反猶太主義的信息」被西門·維森塔爾中心(Simon Wiesenthal Center)和和平創意社區(Creative Communities For Peace)指責。
content_zh:
作者：K.J. 約斯曼

兩個知名的猶太人倡導團體公開指責馬克·魯法洛(Mark Ruffalo)散播「反猶太主義的刻板印象」。

西蒙·維森塔爾中心(Simon Wiesenthal Center)的首席執行官吉姆·伯克(Jim Berk)表示：「言辭很重要，而在合法辯論變成反猶太主義的刻板印象時，劃清界限的意願同樣重要。我們讚揚派拉蒙(Paramount)清楚表達立場，拒絕讓偏見偽裝成政治或企業批評。在反猶太主義常被輕視、合理化或以更社會可接受的語言重新包裝的時候，這種道德清晰度是非常重要的。」

和平創意社群(Creative Community for Peace)的執行董事阿里·恩格爾(Ari Engel)也在聲明中表示：「馬克·魯法洛的言論越來越越過了對以色列的批評，轉向極端和反猶太主義的信息。」

他們的介入是在派拉蒙於週五罕見地發表聲明譴責魯法洛，該公司表示「當反猶太主義的刻板印象被引用以所謂的商業爭端為服務時，我們感到困擾。」

該聲明是針對魯法洛在Instagram上重新發布的一段一年前的視頻片段，視頻中猶太派拉蒙Skydance董事會成員薩夫拉·卡茲(Safra Catz)在小組討論中發言。在附帶的文字中，他告訴他的2000萬Instagram粉絲，這段視頻顯示卡茲「陶醉於」由科技公司甲骨文(Oracle)推動的「種族滅絕」，這被理解為對以色列-哈馬斯衝突的隱晦提及。

卡茲是甲骨文的前首席執行官，該公司由派拉蒙Skydance首席執行官大衛·埃利森(David Ellison)的父親拉里·埃利森(Larry Ellison)共同創立。

派拉蒙Skydance正在收購華納兄弟探索(Warner Bros. Discovery)。魯法洛一直是該交易最直言不諱的批評者之一。

在他最新的社交媒體發言中，魯法洛表示拉里·埃利森正在資助他兒子收購華納，並且如果這筆目前正與12位州檢察總長陷入法律糾紛的交易成功，他將擁有該公司的「大部分」股份。

據報導，拉里·埃利森已承諾在這筆1110億美元的交易中投入高達467億美元，還有來自沙烏地阿拉伯、卡塔爾和阿布達比的三個中東主權財富基金也承諾至少投入240億美元。

魯法洛被認為從他在漫威電影中飾演浩克的角色中賺取了數百萬美元，他在評論中還稱拉里·埃利森為「典型的寡頭」，並表示他們正在「壓榨工人，並為自己的權力和集中統治壟斷世界的財富」。他還指責埃利森家族「推動世界上一些最具破壞性和非人道的力量」。

在派拉蒙發表譴責他帖子的聲明後，這位漫威演員在X平台上回應，稱反猶太主義的指控「令人震驚且根本不誠實」。

然而，至少有兩個猶太組織似乎同意派拉蒙(Paramount)的評估。西蒙·維森塔爾中心(Simon Wiesenthal Center)的執行長伯克(Berk)在他的聲明中表示：“在一個完全無關的問題中提及以色列，這是迷戀和妖魔化的教科書案例。派拉蒙指出這一點是正確的。更多的領導者和機構應該有勇氣將反猶太主義稱為它本身，不論是誰在散播這種言論。”

同時，CCFP的恩格爾(Engel)指出：“拉法洛(Ruffalo)現在表示對他的反猶太主義指控是‘根本不誠實的’。意圖並不能抹去影響。反覆放大煽動性的虛假言論和與歷史反猶太主義典範相似的修辭，幫助使我們在全球再次看到的暴力反猶太仇恨正常化，無論他如何描述自己的動機。”
